10.name: Honey, I'm Home
10.overview: Tired of modern dating, a new batch of hopeful romantics embark on the search for their soulmates — and one pair swiftly finds their prayers answered.

10.name: A Sticky Situation
10.overview: After a blurry beginning, one participant makes a clear-eyed connection and another shares her scars. A man's indecision puts two bonds on thin ice.

10.name: Um, Redo!
10.overview: With multiple dates in play, how do you choose a partner? Tender and tricky talks ensue as singles lay their cards on the table to lock down a fiancé.

10.name: Stage Five Clinger
10.overview: As the clock ticks away, more couples emerge from the pods engaged. Two singles speak candidly about having kids while another is forced to grow up.

10.name: Where the Hell is My Husband?
10.overview: After finally seeing each other for the first time, the couples head to paradise to test their physical chemistry. Will their anticipation match reality?

10.name: Never Have I Ever
10.overview: The couples share intimate moments and spend quality time under the tropical sun. But insecurities flare as the Cabo crew gathers for a pool party.

10.name: Moving In and Unpacking Baggage
10.overview: Back home in Ohio, the couples hope to impress their future in-laws. From man caves to messy bedrooms, the hard work of living together begins.

10.name: A Snake in the Grass
10.overview: As reality sets in, the honeymoon phase wanes for several couples. Nitpicking over chores and candid talks about family planning lead to harsh truths.

10.name: I’m Just Being Honest
10.overview: A stunning reversal leaves one woman speechless and heartbroken. Tensions flare when an ex shows their true colors during a group gathering.

10.name: Vanishing Mode
10.overview: As one guy struggles to get his story straight, another shoots his shot and falls short. Anticipation grows when the gang tries on wedding outfits.

10.name: See Where the Chips Fall
10.overview: With four days to go, the couples wonder: Are they ready for the altar? But first, it's time for bachelor and bachelorette parties — Ohio style

10.name: Head vs Heart
10.overview: Will they say “I do” or catch a limo back to single life? On their wedding day, the couples walk down the aisle to decide if love is truly blind.

11.name: Enchanted to Meet You
11.overview: Eager to strike a swift love match, hopeful singles get the romance rolling by bonding over astrology, dad jokes and their tastes in music.

11.name: What a Woman!
11.overview: Flying sparks or mixed signals? From health diagnoses to having kids, the conversations turn serious as participants try to uncover real chemistry.

11.name: Together at Last
11.overview: As one pair leaps into a proposal, messy love triangles, shallow comments and fumbled chances haunt singles still searching for a partner.

11.name: Sink or Swim
11.overview: Two more couples prepare for a magic moment beyond the pods. Will the bond they've built behind closed doors sizzle or fizzle once they're face to face?

11.name: Here Comes the Dud
11.overview: After finally seeing one another in person, the newly engaged couples fly to a luxurious resort in Mexico to test their physical chemistry in paradise.

11.name: When You Know You Know
11.overview: A pool party brings all the pairs together for the first time. While one duo playfully pictures their future, another fixates on past dates in the pods.

11.name: Happy Wife, Happy Life
11.overview: The couples leave paradise for Boston, where real-world logistics and chilly receptions from loved ones stoke anxiety about their fate beyond the pods.

11.name: Under Pressure
11.overview: Hairy habits and domestic dealbreakers emerge when the couples tour each other's homes. First meetings with families put some bonds under the microscope.

11.name: Buzz Kill
11.overview: Compatibility is critical as the couples tackle finances and family dynamics. For one participant, a rowdy night out leads to a sobering realization.

11.name: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
11.overview: During a gathering of the full Pod Squad, old flames spark renewed tension — and an on-camera crashout that serves the rest with a reality check.

11.name: If Not Now, When?
11.overview: The brides and grooms try on gowns and tuxes. Health scares and honest conversations put some relationships in perspective as the big day draws near.

overview: Nick and Vanessa Lachey host this social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A new journey begins for singles seeking transformative love — sight unseen. Who will find romance and who will come face to face with heartbreak?

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Riding an emotional roller coaster from the pods to the altar, a new group of singles must decide if they dare to propose to someone they've never seen.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: More single people who are ready to prioritize love over looks hit the pods to flirt, fall and — if they're lucky — find someone they want to marry.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Hoping to find their future fiancés by talking through walls, a new group of men and women braves twists, turns and triangles in search of true love.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Singles in Charlotte shake up their search for love by entering the pods and embarking on a wild journey of romance and self-discovery over four weeks.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: A new group of singles enters the pods, ready to abandon superficial judgments and face possible heartbreak to find true love and lasting commitments.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: A new group of singles face the ultimate dating experiment. Will they find their soulmates and get married, or will looks get in the way of love?

tagline: See love from a new perspective.
title: Love Is Blind
